learning_outcomes.text: Ability to work efficiently in intra-disciplinary teams.
Knowledge about the effects of engineering practices on health, environment, and security at universal and societal dimensions and the problems that are reflected in the engineering field of the era.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of Food Quality Control and Food Safety Management Systems
General Principles in Quality Control Application: Definition of Food, Brief History of Quality Control in Food
Principles of Quality Control in Food
Responsibilities and Organization of the Quality Control Department
Process Control and Control Cards with Statistical Operation
Sample Taking, Preparation, Preservation and Analysis of Foodstuffs
